'''Bendhuin''' is of the [[Green Salts]] [[sept]] and the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] clan. He is the head of the [[Shaido]] ''[[Far Aldazar Din]]'', a Brother to the Eagle.

== Appearance ==
He is a scar-faced man.

== Activities ==
He fights in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].

The Green Salt sept is scattered by [[Sammael]]'s call-boxes and eventually regroup in the town of [[Malden]]. There he is given permission by [[Therava]] to leave for [[Rhuidean]] to become [[clan chief]] of the Shaido.
